capability_investigated:
generate(features, prompts, ...) signature and the WhisperFeatureExtractor
output shape — specifically whether the decode call accepts a batched
StorageView (N x n_mels x 3000) with a parallel prompt list rather than a
single 30s window.
what_i_learned:
The processor pads/truncates every input to a fixed 30s mel window, so the
stub silently dropped everything past the first 30 seconds of each call
(pure deletion). generate takes a list of prompts, so a batched feature
StorageView with one prompt per window decodes all segments in a single
call and returns one result per window.
hypothesis:
Split audio into ceil(len/30s) non-overlapping 30s windows, extract all
features at once, run one batched generate over [prompt]*N, and join the
per-window transcripts. This recovers the deleted tail and should sharply
raise length_ratio.p05 / cut the deletion rate that dominates the stub.
